title: Dxcufgb's Debug Recorder
description: A GM helper for bug reports about Dxcufgb's modules. While recording it collects versions, settings, errors, warnings and what the modules report about themselves into one JSON file to attach to a GitHub issue, together with steps to reproduce and what you expected. Names, chat and journal text, the world's title and the server's address are removed before anything is stored, and a preview shows exactly what the file contains.
